title: Baker Mayfield: Disappointing to lose Mike Evans, but we have a lot of weapons

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Baker Mayfield: Disappointing to lose Mike Evans, but we have a lot of weapons
sources.description: Baker Mayfield's take on his contract situation was the juiciest bit of information to come out of his first media session of the offseason, but he also had a chance to weigh in on a significant change to the team's receiving corps.
